title: Barber: one to two craft a year recovered over his range

tellings.quote: public, he would say over his specific range 1 to two a year.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels what Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he helped retrieve a UFO, has said in public. According to UAPGerb, Barber says that over his own test range alone, one to two craft a year were recovered. If true, it would mean such recoveries are a routine affair.
